name.description: Your full name as you would like it to appear on your volunteer certificate.
name.purpose: We use this to identify you and to personalise certificates.

email.description: A valid email address that you can access.
email.purpose: We use your email to send event confirmations, certificate notifications and important updates.

phone.description: A South African phone number we can reach you on if needed.
phone.purpose: Optional — only used for urgent coordination on event days.

city.description: The city or town you live in.
city.purpose: Helps us suggest drives that are close to you.

skills.description: Any skills or interests that could help during volunteer drives.
skills.purpose: Helps us match you to the right kind of activity.

password.description: A password with at least 8 characters.
password.purpose: Secures your account. Keep it private.

name.purpose: So we know who we're replying to.

email.purpose: We reply to enquiries by email.

subject.description: A short label for your enquiry.
subject.purpose: Helps us route your message to the right person.

message.purpose: Tell us what you'd like to know or how we can help.
message.example: I'd like to know more about the Spring Drive.

donor_name.description: Your name, or leave blank if you'd like to donate anonymously.
donor_name.purpose: So we can acknowledge your donation (unless you've chosen to remain anonymous).

donor_email.purpose: We send donation receipts and updates here.

amount.description: The amount you'd like to donate in South African Rand.
amount.purpose: Choose a preset amount or enter a custom value.

quantity_description.description: Describe the items you're donating, with rough quantities.
quantity_description.purpose: Helps us plan collection or drop-off.
quantity_description.example: 5kg rice, 3 tins pilchards, 2 bags of clothing

message.description: An optional message to accompany your donation.
message.purpose: We love hearing from our donors.
